canResolve.bribeWhyNot: He laughs in your face: {{amount}} cr short.
canResolve.bribeHintFail: Stands down for {{cr}} cr — certain, but far out of reach for now.
canResolve.bribeHintOk: Stands down for {{cr}} cr. No risk: he takes it and vanishes.
canResolve.serviceHintFail: He wants a favor before standing down: {{list}}
canResolve.serviceHintOk: You meet his terms ({{list}}). He stands down without a word.
canResolve.serviceNotAccepted: He is waiting for an answer. Commit: {{list}}
canResolve.servicePactBroken: {{name}} does not renegotiate. You gave your word once.
canResolve.servicePactBrokenHint: Bargain broken. Only force or money remain.

resolve.manipulateSuccess: You stage a setup tailored to him: "{{trait}}." You exploit exactly that. {{name}} takes the bait and withdraws, convinced he made the right call. He'll never understand. -{{cr}} cr.
resolve.manipulateFail: {{name}} lets you spin your lie... then smiles. "You take me for a rookie?" He saw through it. -{{cr}} cr, -{{hp}} HP, and he draws his weapon. You have to fight.
resolve.sabotageSuccess: You rig his systems ahead of time — {{mechanic}}. When {{name}} tries to react, nothing responds. Neutralized without a shot fired. -2 Electronic components.
resolve.sabotageFail: The sabotage goes wrong — an alarm triggers. {{name}} now knows you came for him, and he's ready for you. -2 Electronic components.
resolve.allySuccess: You don't fight him: you offer him something better. "{{motivation}}" — you show him your path serves that goal better than {{boss}} ever will. {{name}} hesitates for a long time... then shakes your hand. He switches sides, and opens the doors to {{boss}}. +{{reward}} cr, +standing, +reputation.
resolve.betraySuccess: You play the friend, the ally, the comrade. {{name}} lowers his guard — the first mistake of his career, and the last. You take everything: +{{loot}} cr. But {{boss}} will know how his lieutenant fell, and the whole sector will remember your method. -standing, -reputation.
resolve.bribeSuccess: {{name}} counts the {{cr}} cr twice, then waves his men to lower their weapons. "Nothing personal. Tell {{boss}} the rate went up."
resolve.serviceSuccess: {{name}} checks that you kept your word, nods once, and steps aside. "One favor deserves another. {{boss}} doesn't need to know."

missing.visitStation: you have never set foot on {{station}}
missing.day: day {{value}} — he will not deal before day {{needed}}
missing.subBoss: one of his rivals must fall first

pact.accepted: {{name}} stares at you for a long moment, then nods. The bargain is struck: {{list}}. Come back when it is done — he does not like waiting.
pact.broken: You tell {{name}} the bargain is off. He says nothing. That is far worse than shouting: he will never offer you anything again.
pact.journalAccepted: Bargain struck with {{name}}, at {{station}}. He expects me to keep my word.
pact.journalHonored: Bargain honored. {{name}} stood down without another word.
pact.journalBroken: I broke my word with {{name}}. He will remember.
